purpose: Deterministic offline engineering and geospatial context using the newest authoritative agency product available at acquisition time. This manifest records the selected vintage and provenance; it does not turn TSM into an agency decision-maker.

snapshot_policy.selection: Select the newest officially published product that covers Posey County and is appropriate to the authority class.
snapshot_policy.freeze: After acquisition, preserve the exact product vintage, retrieval timestamp, source URL, native CRS, vertical datum, software/model lineage, and SHA-256.
snapshot_policy.replacement: A newer product supersedes an older snapshot only when its agency publication metadata or source record establishes that it is newer.
snapshot_policy.offline_rule: Runtime consumes the frozen snapshot and manifest; internet access is not required after acquisition.
snapshot_policy.authority_rule: FEMA effective mapping, Indiana best-available/regulatory mapping, USGS scientific products, and USACE evidence/modeling products remain separate authority classes.

authorities.vintage_rule: Use the effective panel/FIS/NFHL metadata date for the Posey County feature or panel. Do not use the retrieval date as a substitute for the FEMA effective date.

authorities.selected_vintage: newest Posey County 3DEP product available at acquisition
authorities.vintage_rule: Select by USGS product/acquisition metadata; retain acquisition date, quality level, native CRS, vertical datum, geoid model, and product identifier.
authorities.historical_baseline: 2017-2020 Indiana Statewide LiDAR Phase 2 West remains available as a historical comparison layer, not the current terrain default.

authorities.selected_vintage: latest downloaded historical/reference package at acquisition
product_scope: Wabash River at New Harmony station 03378500
authorities.vintage_rule: For offline data, freeze the downloaded observation/history interval and the publication revision or study package date. Never label a frozen observation as live.

authorities.agency: Indiana Department of Natural Resources, Division of Water
authorities.role: Indiana best-available floodplain and state regulatory/planning context
authorities.selected_vintage: newest published Posey County BAFL extraction at acquisition
authorities.vintage_rule: Use the county extraction's published/download metadata. Preserve native CRS EPSG:26916 and NAVD88 where supplied by the product.

authorities.selected_vintage: newest published Posey County/statewide product at acquisition
authorities.vintage_rule: Record the actual county/product acquisition or publication year from service metadata; do not infer a 2026 imagery vintage merely because the service is current.

authorities.role: Levee inventory, condition/inspection and geospatial evidence
authorities.selected_vintage: latest NLD record for each Posey County levee at acquisition
authorities.vintage_rule: Use each levee record's Data Last Updated and Last Assessment Date. NLD is continuously updated; one county-wide date must not be invented.

authorities.agency: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Hydrologic Engineering Center
authorities.selected_vintage: HEC-RAS 7.0.1 release for the current runtime; model/project vintage recorded separately
authorities.vintage_rule: Pin the executable version and project/model artifact hash separately. Solver version is not a substitute for the source-data vintage.

legacy_policy.historical_firm_scans: Retain only as historical comparison evidence; never override current FEMA effective mapping.
legacy_policy.2017_2020_lidar: Retain as historical terrain baseline; do not present as newest terrain when a newer USGS/Indiana product exists.
legacy_policy.live_api_records: May be used to acquire a snapshot, but the offline runtime must consume the frozen snapshot and its manifest after acquisition.
legacy_policy.project_curated_constants: Remain project evidence until independently sourced and reviewed; never promote them into agency authority.
